about: AV* rated by Martindale-Hubbell and included in the publication Best Lawyers in America, attorney John W. McLuskey is a distinguished trial lawyer practicing in the areas of civil litigation with emphasis on civil trial practice, including personal injury, medical malpractice, products liability, insurance law, commercial litigation and disability insurance law. Mr. McLuskey is board certified in civil trial law through the Florida Bar Association's certification program and he has written and lectured on various legal issues related to civil trial litigation through-out his 40 years of practice. Mr. McLuskey has been elected to the Florida Trend Legal Elite, received Advanced Trial Advocacy recognition from the National Institute for Trial Advocacy and received the Merit Award of Recognition for Trial Skills by The American Association for Justice and is a member of ABOTA.

A practicing attorney for 40 years, Mr. McLuskey is admitted to practice within the state of Florida and is also admitted to practice before the Southern and Middle U.S. District Courts of Florida, before the 11th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals and the U.S. Supreme Court. Mr. McLuskey received his law degree from the University of Miami School of Law in Coral Gables, Florida.

*AV Preeminent is registered certification used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the confidential opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell ratings fall into two categories: legal ability and general ethical standards with AV Preeminent the highest certification.
